evals.name: personal-habit-app
evals.prompt: Build me a web app for my own use: a daily habit tracker. I add habits, tick them off each day, and see the last 4 weeks as a streak grid. Keep data in localStorage. One self-contained index.html I can open in a browser. I want it to look tasteful, not like a generic AI app.
evals.expected_output: A working single-file HTML app in plain HTML/CSS/JS (no framework), restrained motion, no decorative imagery or hero, no em-dashes, no overused fonts, passes impeccable's detector.

evals.name: thai-landing-page
evals.prompt: Make a landing page for a YouTube channel about practical AI tools for Thai office workers. Bilingual Thai and English. It should feel premium and not AI-generated. One self-contained index.html.
evals.expected_output: A single-file landing page with a Thai-capable font, Thai-safe line heights, no negative tracking on Thai, light and dark themes, reduced-motion support, no em-dashes, passes impeccable's detector.
